propositions: Failed pre-create pending save must produce zero provider calls and item-scoped persistence failure.
After Jira returns a key, canonical label must be attached first, entity property second, then persisted through RP-02 unit-of-work without deleting on failure.
Create timeout or connection loss must never blind-replay; observation or deferred pending record must prevent duplicate issues across restart.
Cloud/DC crash-restart sequences must produce exactly one remote issue and converge to one confirmed binding.
Keyed recovery must perform zero search; keyless negative search requires both three misses and 3600-second conjunction.
Lifecycle intents must execute only after proven remote postconditions while preserving create-before-link, hierarchy deferral, tombstone suppression, and per-ticket tallies.
